title: BAUX Experiment and Tuning Specification
description: Closed schema for BAUX version 4 experiment recipes. The optimizer variant fixes the exact component tables that are valid for a run.

version.description: Experiment configuration schema version. Must be 4.

experiment.description: Experiment workflow type: 'pretrain' for foundation model pretraining or 'generation' for sequence generation tasks.

model.description: Architecture preset for pretraining. 'fbt-pisa1-mhc4-v1' specifies the PISA / mHC / MoE model.

output.description: Optional destination directory for serialized run records, checkpoints, and telemetry logs.

train.description: Filesystem path to training corpus token split.

validation.description: Filesystem path to held-out validation token split.

objective.description: Objective function and likelihood evaluation protocol.

function.description: Objective loss function evaluated over sequence tokens: 'cross-entropy' (-log p) or 'bounded-log-likelihood' (log(2 - p)).

sampling.description: Corpus sampling strategy: 'natural' streams contiguous tokens from pretraining corpus without artificial padding.

window-tokens.description: Tokens per causal evaluation window (e.g., 4096, 65536, 1048576 for 1M context).

reference.description: Reference baseline for contrastive evaluations: 'moving-incumbent' computes relative reward over current best parameters; 'frozen-initial' uses initialization baseline.

execution.description: Execution budget and system target; no optimizer behavior or held-out policy belongs here.

rounds.description: Total optimizer rounds / transactions to execute.

round-target-ms.description: Requested round latency threshold in milliseconds.

evaluation.description: Held-out measurement policy; evaluation observations never train the optimizer.

interval.description: Held-out evaluation cadence in optimizer transactions.

optimizer.description: Optimizer recipe defining candidate generation, surrogate model, acquisition function, and trust-region dynamics.

algorithm.description: Optimization algorithm: 'operator-bo' (Direct Neural Operator BO), 'turbo-enn' (TuRBO trust region with ENN), 'muon', or 'adamw'.

generator.description: Procedural proposal method. 'lie' applies continuous representation Lie algebra operator flows; 'pair-rotation' applies pairwise orthogonal rotation; 'independent' applies coordinate-wise noise.

candidates.description: Total proposals generated per round across all arms.

arms.description: Number of procedural seed namespaces sharing the current incumbent center.

surrogate.description: Surrogate model architecture, distance geometry, uncertainty scales, and fitting procedure.

estimator.description: Surrogate estimator type: 'enn' (Epistemic Neural Network) or 'knn' (Kernel Nearest-Neighbor).

neighbors.description: Number of nearest history neighbors k used for prediction.

neighbor-rule.description: Query-local neighbor adaptation rule: 'fixed' uses constant k neighbors; 'risk-prefix' contracts k based on local epistemic risk.

scaling.description: Distance normalization mode across parameter dimensions: 'global' applies uniform isotropic scaling; 'self-tuning' dynamically adapts scaling to local neighbor density; 'hyperbolic' applies Poincaré upper half-space dissimilarity.

geometry.description: Coordinate geometry for parameter distance calculation: 'latent' evaluates distance in perturbation space; 'realized' evaluates post-quantization weight distance.

local-neighbors.description: Local neighborhood rank for self-tuning or hyperbolic distance scaling.

fit.description: Surrogate scale fitting rule; independent of query-local neighbor-count selection.

fit-candidates.description: Hyperparameter configurations considered by leave-one-out fitting; not optimizer proposals.

fit-samples.description: Retained observations scored per fitting configuration; not fresh objective evaluations.

acquisition.description: Acquisition function for selecting proposals under uncertainty.

beta.description: Exploration weight beta for Upper Confidence Bound (UCB).

scales.description: Objective scales for multi-objective Pareto acquisition.

preferences.description: Preference weights for augmented Chebyshev acquisition.

seed-domain.description: Seed domain identifier for multi-objective acquisition.

criterion.description: Condition required to accept candidate over incumbent: 'positive-improvement' requires measured reward > incumbent baseline.

trust-region.description: TuRBO trust region bounds and contraction/expansion policy.

policy.description: Trust region update policy: 'turbo' (consecutive success/failure count) or 'morbo' (multi-region).

initial.description: Initial trust region radius (dimensionless multiplier on block scales).

shape.description: Trust region geometry shape across parameter blocks.

failure-tolerance.description: Consecutive non-improvements before contracting the radius (TuRBO contract). Set > 0 to enable TuRBO failure-counting contractions.

evidence-decay.description: Discount factor applied to past model adequacy evidence.

confidence-z.description: Standardized residual tolerance z for local model adequacy.

reliability-threshold.description: Lower adequacy probability required to expand the region.

minimum-evidence.description: Effective observations required before adequacy modifies the radius.

acceptance-ratio.description: Minimum realized-to-predicted improvement ratio for expansion.

boundary-fraction.description: Minimum fraction of trust region radius reached by accepted step.

expand-factor.description: Multiplicative radius expansion factor upon successful step.

shrink-factor.description: Multiplicative radius contraction factor upon failure.

regions.description: Count of trust regions for multi-region MORBO.

radius-control.description: Trust-region and adaptive radius control dynamics for operator-bo recipes.

policy.description: Radius control policy: 'turbo' adapts radius by streak counting.

initial.description: Initial trust region radius (dimensionless multiplier on block scales).

min.description: Minimum allowed trust region radius; bounds search above quantization deadzones.

max.description: Maximum allowed trust region radius; prevents step explosion in non-Euclidean manifold exploration.

shape.description: Trust region geometry shape across parameter blocks.

failure-tolerance.description: Consecutive non-improvements before contracting the radius. Set > 0 to enable failure-counting contractions.

evidence-decay.description: Discount factor applied to past model adequacy evidence in moving-average reliability estimates.

confidence-z.description: Standardized residual tolerance z for local surrogate model adequacy tests.

reliability-threshold.description: Lower adequacy probability threshold required before triggering trust region expansion.

minimum-evidence.description: Effective observations required before adequacy modifies the trust region radius.

acceptance-ratio.description: Minimum realized-to-predicted improvement ratio for trust region expansion.

boundary-fraction.description: Minimum fraction of trust region radius reached by accepted step to warrant expansion.

expand-factor.description: Multiplicative radius expansion factor upon successful, boundary-reaching accepted steps.

shrink-factor.description: Multiplicative radius contraction factor upon consecutive failures or model inadequacy.

diagnostics.description: Performance profiling, trace capture, and kernel audit settings.

stage-samples.description: Sample count for stage timing profiling.
